evals.prompt: Write a PRD for letting clients set a monthly savings goal in our mobile banking app. We know from analytics that 31% of active users open the savings tab weekly. No research on goals yet.
evals.expected_output: A PRD that keeps the 31% figure as [Observed] with its source, labels the goal-setting need as [Assumption], lists research as an uncertainty with an owner, includes Must requirements with Given/When/Then, WCAG 2.2 AA requirements, success metric with baseline and guardrails, and out-of-scope items.
assertions: The 31% figure is the only quantitative user data and is labelled [Observed]
The need for savings goals is labelled as an assumption
Every Must requirement has Given/When/Then criteria
